introduction: With this video piece, the people in this work are actual Parkinson’s disease patients.To shoot this video I went to several cities in China. It was hard to find these type of patients who were agreeable to being filmed, and I paid them for their time. This is a project which includes 5 – 6 works, already shown at Meulensteen Gallery (NYC), and will next be shown at Boers Li Gallery in Beijing, my next solo show. My other video projects are available as well through ART LABOR Gallery in Shanghai.All video and soundtrack/music was done by myself.
